text: This is the last video in the series: the handoff documentation that lets someone else -- a future hire, Riverside's own IT team -- actually maintain this platform without calling you at two in the morning.

Five documents matter most: a data dictionary that locks down the exact sales formula from the very first meeting, an ERD of the star schema, an SSIS operations runbook with concrete re-run steps, an SSRS report catalog, and a Power BI refresh and access document.

A known-issues section gets included deliberately -- the Lesson 17 bug and its fix, the Lesson 19 performance fix -- because it proves the system has already been through real troubleshooting, and saves a future maintainer from re-diagnosing something that's already understood.

The package gets handed over with a thirty-minute live walkthrough, in a location Riverside's own team already uses -- because reading a document alone isn't the same as someone trusting it under pressure.
Twenty-three videos ago, this started with one meeting and a vague ask for better reporting. It ends here, handed off, documented, and running every single night on its own.
